question: Buddhadev Dasgupta is famous for playing which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Buddhadev Dasgupta** was an eminent Indian classical musician known for his remarkable proficiency in playing the Sarod.
 
• He was born on **1 February 1933** and was a disciple of the famous Sarod player **Radhika Mohan Maitra**.
 
• Buddhadev Dasgupta was a key figure in **popularizing Sarod** music across the globe and was renowned for his unique style and innovative approach.
 
• He was honored with several prestigious awards, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Padma Bhushan** for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarod**

 
 
• The Sarod is a stringed musical instrument, used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its deep, weighty, introspective sound.
 
• The Sarod is believed to have descended from the Afghan rubab and is known for its rich and resonant sound.
 
• It typically has 17 to 25 strings, with 4 to 5 main strings used for playing the melody, and the rest being drone and sympathetic strings.
 
 
 
• **Sarangi**
 
 
• The Sarangi is a bowed, short-necked string instrument from India and Nepal, which is used primarily in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is known for its ability to closely imitate the human voice.
 
 
 
• **Bansuri**
 
 
• The Bansuri is a side-blown flute found in many parts of India.
 
• It is traditionally made of bamboo and has six or seven finger holes.
 
 
 
• **Mridangam**
 
 
• The Mridangam is a percussion instrument from India, especially South India.
 
• It is the primary rhythmic accompaniment in a Carnatic music ensemble.
